Fomovet/clipkeep.description: A Windows clipboard history tool: a single exe with unlimited entries, search, grouping, editing, and encrypted LAN transfer. Rust + Tauri 2 + Vue 3.
Fomovet/clipkeep.body:
# clipkeep

Windows / macOS clipboard history tool

The built-in Win+V on Windows only stores 25 entries, unpinned items are cleared on restart, and there is no way to search them. clipkeep also opens with Win+V, but it keeps records indefinitely, supports search and grouping, and can send text to another computer on the LAN.

## Download and install

Download from [Releases](https://github.com/Fomovet/clipkeep/releases/latest). The installer and the single-file version have the same features. The differences are:

|  | Installer (recommended) | Single-file version |
|---|---|---|
| File | `clipkeep_x.y.z_x64-setup.exe` | `clipkeep_x.y.z_x64.exe` |
| Installation | Installs to the current user's directory, no administrator rights needed | Put it in any directory and run it directly |
| Auto-start on boot | Enabled automatically after the first run | Enable manually in settings |
| Upgrade | Run the new installer to overwrite | Replace the exe file |
| Uninstall | Uninstall in System "Settings → Apps" | Turn off auto-start in settings first, then delete the exe |

- System requirements: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit), depends on the WebView2 runtime (usually already included in the system; the installer adds it automatically if missing)
- History and settings are saved in `%APPDATA%\com.clipkeep.clipboard\`. Upgrading and uninstalling do not delete them. To remove everything completely, delete this directory manually.
- The program runs as administrator, so opening it manually shows a UAC prompt once. Auto-start does not show a prompt. For the reason, see [FAQ](#常见问题).

After installation, press Win+V to use it.

### macOS (Apple Silicon)

This fork also provides a native macOS (arm64) version. Its features and interaction match the Windows version. Only the platform-specific implementations are replaced with the AppKit / Carbon / WKWebView equivalents.

- Download the `.dmg` from this repository's Releases and drag `clipkeep.app` into Applications. If Gatekeeper blocks the first launch, right-click and choose "Open".
- The first time you use "Paste to original window", macOS asks you to grant **Accessibility** permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility). Global hotkeys, clipboard recording, and copying do not require this permission.
- The default hotkey is `⌘⇧V`. Other combinations in settings are marked with `⌃` / `⌥` / `⇧`. The macOS version has no in-app auto-update. To update, download the new `.dmg` from the release page and overwrite the old one.
- Data directory: `~/Library/Application Support/com.clipkeep.clipboard/`. Auto-start is managed by a LaunchAgent and can be toggled in settings.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

arnow117/sdlc-pilot.description: A self-consistent, portable, always-current SDLC skill family: a driver, 6 process skills, role cards, and a validate mode, distilled from superpowers/gstack/GSD/agency-agents
arnow117/sdlc-pilot.body:
# sdlc-pilot

> A lightweight, portable, plain-file SDLC skill family: advance work with stage skills, add professional perspectives with role cards, and share state and context through Git.

## Core model

1. **Product context** uses Markdown to record the problem, scope, behavioral scenarios, domain judgments, the sources of the currently bound decisions, and acceptance criteria.
2. **Engineering context** uses Markdown to record the design, Task breakdown, and plan verification within one currently valid plan. Actual verification, review, and release evidence use existing independent sections or references.
3. **Shared progress** is written only to the target repository's `.sdlc-v1/state.json`.
4. **Collaboration and history** use ordinary Git branches, commits, push, and pull/merge. No second version history is maintained.
5. **Long-term engineering context** can come from the repository's own `AGENTS.md`, architecture/product docs, and an optional repo-context index. SDLC only records verified paths in `project.md`; it does not copy their body text or state.

Once in the lifecycle, the main Agent uses `next` to select a stage, define the complete work contract, dispatch one sub-agent that actually executes the work, accept its file and command evidence, then update state and continue. Sub-agents do not edit `state.json` or call lifecycle mutations. They can only return pending acceptance, incomplete, or blocked. When the runtime has no sub-agent capability, the main Agent runs the same steps serially in the same order and discloses the fallback. This only describes the dispatch topology. It cannot replace the Terra responsibilities the project requires, and it cannot be called independent review. When the required Terra or independent Sol is unavailable, report the limitation honestly and continue only the authorized read-only or simple documentation work. The full convention is in [`stage-agent-protocol.md`](https://github.com/arnow117/sdlc-pilot/blob/HEAD/skills/sdlc/references/stage-agent-protocol.md). It does not introduce a new runtime, event records, behavioral Eval, or automatic retrospective.

For authorized small projects that are single-repo, single-module, and have clear product and delivery boundaries, the main Agent by default prefers to dispatch a continuous candidate sequence, Backlog → Spec → Plan, to the same preparing executor in one batch, within the eligibility scope of that protocol. The main Agent still accepts each block in turn and executes in the original CLI order. An existing ready Requirement only prepares a Plan. An existing Feature continues from its actual next stage. Open choices, prototype confirmation, external authorization, and complex interface, migration, concurrency, or recovery risks continue through the normal stages and cannot be skipped by batching.

Product and R&D are two perspectives on the same lifecycle, not two storage systems synced with each other:

```text
Requirement: captured → ready → in_delivery →…
```

# Genshin Impact (原神) University Alliance

Welcome to the Genshin Impact University Alliance project! This project aims to collect and organize lists of Genshin-related universities from across the country (currently 314 universities, 81 of them valid), providing a campus hub.

Non-university entries can be added too~

If you like this project, please give it a star on [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University).
**This list prioritizes valid domains. Within each validity group, schools are sorted alphabetically by school name.**

## How to Submit
:::caution
**You must purchase a domain from a cloud provider and configure the corresponding DNS resolution and redirects before it can be listed on this site. You must also test that the domain opens normally in a browser; otherwise it cannot be listed on this site.**
:::
1. **Go to the project**: Click [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University) at the top right.
2. **Fork this repository**: Find and click the "Fork" button at the top right of the page to copy this project to your GitHub account.
3. **Clone the repository**: Clone the repository you just forked to your local computer.
4. **Create a new branch**: Create a new branch for the changes you plan to make.
5. **Add a domain**: In the new folder in your branch, add your domain following the instructions in the README there.
6. **Open a Pull Request**: Open a Pull Request on GitHub to merge your changes into the original repository. Before opening it, make sure your changes are accurate and have been tested.
7. **If you're not comfortable with GitHub operations, fill in the survey directly: [Genshin University Information Collection](https://wj.qq.com/s2/14161038/95a1/). Make sure you have registered the domain and set up the redirect.**
8. **Other questions: email howen.huang@qq.com**

   **Format requirement: your school name + the domain you set up. Make sure your link has been tested by others and can be accessed.**

czg86389-hub/ACP-Ant.body:
# ACP-Ant

Turn Google's official **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** into a standard large-model interface via the **ACP protocol (Agent Client Protocol)**: **OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages** formats are all supported, with **tool calling (function calling)**, so agents and applications can connect directly.
Supports **multiple Google accounts used in rotation, with each account going through its own proxy node**.
Starting from 1.5.0, you can also connect **Google AI Studio as a second source**: same address, same key, `aistudio/<model name>` goes to AI Studio, and the rest go to Antigravity. The quotas of the same Google account on both sides can be used.

- Uses Google's official command-line program and official protocol. No packet capture, no reverse-proxying of web login credentials.
- Codex CLI, OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Dify, Cline, OpenCode… anything that supports an OpenAI or Anthropic interface works once you fill in the address, key, and model name.
- With multiple accounts, traffic is distributed automatically. When an account runs out of quota, is rate-limited, or requires verification, it automatically switches to the next account.
- **AI Studio second source (optional)**: start [AIStudio2API](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API) with one command, then log in to Google from the panel using a browser on the server. It does not depend on your computer, and the session stays valid long-term. AI Studio models such as Gemini 4 Hydrogen are all usable. See [AI Studio second source](#ai-studio-第二路可选150-起) for details.
- **Web control panel**: add accounts, log in to Google, change proxies, view each account's quota, enable or disable accounts, and run automatic inspections. Everything is done by clicking in the web page, with no commands to type. The Antigravity and AI Studio sources are shown by email on the same account card.

jin66god/workbuddy2api-panel.body:
Account pool rotation · Cooldown and circuit breaking · Session stickiness · Scheduled check-in / activity / travel / keep-alive · Growth task automation · Web search

---

> **This repository** is an independent enhanced fork of [linguo2625469/workbuddy2api-panel](https://github.com/linguo2625469/workbuddy2api-panel), intended for **personal use** multi-account operations.
> Binaries, Docker images, and Releases are based on this repository: `ghcr.io/jin66god/workbuddy2api`.
>
> ⚠️ Only for managing accounts you are authorized to manage. **Prohibited**: bulk registration, reselling quota, repackaging, or card-key distribution. See [Usage Statement](#使用声明必读).

## Usage Statement (Must Read)

This project is a free, open-source tool provided "as is" for personal use, for managing your own CodeBuddy accounts (check-ins, keep-alive, providing an OpenAI-compatible entry point for local tools).

- **Prohibited**: bulk registration / acquiring accounts and then offering paid APIs, shared pools, or proxy top-ups to others;
- **Prohibited**: secondary repackaging, bundling card-key sales, or charging under the name of "public welfare servers" or "low-price relays";
- Any commercial or sales activity is unrelated to this project and its author; consequences are borne solely by the person responsible;
- This project will always be free and open source. Any "paid version" you buy is a tampered product made by others and may steal plaintext credentials in `auths/`;
- If abuse continues, the author reserves the right to stop maintenance or close the repository at any time.

## Project Overview

WorkBuddy2API is a self-hosted **OpenAI-compatible reverse proxy gateway**: it connects CodeBuddy accounts via OAuth device authorization or static API keys, performs automatic token refresh, account pool scheduling, and traffic governance on the gateway side, and exposes only standard interfaces to clients, so existing SDKs / frontends / tools can connect with zero modifications.

- Multiple accounts shared; automatic account switching on single-account failure;
- Cooldown, circuit breaking, and in-flight leases prevent cascading failures;
- Session stickiness keeps multi-turn context from jumping accounts;
- The panel visualizes management of accounts, tasks, configuration, and logs.

> ⚠️ Unofficial gateway; only for your own authorized accounts and local / private environment testing. See [Security and Compliance](#安全与合规) for compliance boundaries.

## Core Capabilities

| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| 🔑 **One-click OAuth login** | Supports three login sites: China site / international site (codebuddy.ai) / legacy desktop client (workbuddy.ai). The device authorization flow automatically saves credentials to disk and hot-loads them into the pool |
| 🔄 **Multi-account pool** | Accounts with points expiring soonest take priority (hard priority) + cost tiers + weighted random / round-robin / sequential exhaustion, Top-5 candidates + thundering-herd prevention |
| 💾 **Controlled write amplification** | The scheduling cursor is only persisted on shutdown: account selection no longer triggers `state.json` rewrites (previously an fsync every 5 seconds under traffic); the round-robin position still resumes after restart |

kadaliao/open-super-agent.body:
# open-super-agent

**A self-hostable, always-on AI teammate: it chats, delegates tasks, and has a computer that can see and take over.**

Open source, and an alternative to [Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot). Choose your own model, billed by token.

Simplified Chinese · [English](https://github.com/kadaliao/open-super-agent/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

## Highlights

- **Chats and delegates**: Each Bot has its own persona, memory, and conversations. Time-consuming work goes to background tasks while you keep chatting, and you can see what each step did. Several Bots can join a group: one looks up material, and its findings are automatically handed to another to write a summary.
- **A shared knowledge base written together**: Plans and reports made by Bots are saved as pages that you can edit directly, like Notion. Several Bots can continue writing the same page section by section, with each section marked by its author. Leave a comment on a section and the Bot that wrote it will revise it and reply to you in the comments. Every version can be viewed and rolled back. You can also create databases to use as task boards. Claude Code and Codex can read and write them via MCP, and Notion content can be imported.
- **A computer that can see and take over**: Bots look up information, fill in forms, and download files on a computer, and you can watch the screen in real time. For steps like CAPTCHAs and logins, the Bot asks you to do them. Multiple tasks can run at once, each in its own browser window, without queuing.
  The computer can be the Bot's own, or it can be your Mac. Once you grant permission, it can operate apps like WeChat, Finder, and Notes with the mouse and keyboard, and it stops as soon as you move the mouse.

# ZSDesk

A Windows multi-tab file manager and desktop fences. Browse multiple folders in one window, organize files with dual panes, or group and store desktop files.

## Choosing a Version

| Edition | Best for |
|---|---|
| **Full edition** | Use when unsure; includes file management, network access, and desktop fences |
| Standard edition | File management, search, and preview only |
| Network edition | Standard edition plus FTP, SFTP/SSH, and network drives |
| Desktop edition | Standard edition plus desktop fences |
| Theme edition | Full features, adds Mica, acrylic, and light/dark materials; separate configuration |
| Standalone desktop box edition | Desktop organization only; excludes the file manager window and search |

Each edition is available as an installer and a portable ZIP. Regular users should choose the installer whose name contains `setup.exe`. For the portable version, extract it and run `ZSDesk.exe`, keeping the entire program directory and the `data` configuration directory.

1. After installing or extracting, open ZSDesk and first get familiar with the controls using ordinary folders.
2. Press **Ctrl+T** to open a new tab, **Ctrl+L** to enter a directory, and **Ctrl+F** to search.
3. In **≡ → Layout**, enable dual panes and adjust tab position and the command bar; each pane keeps its own directory and tabs.
4. To replace the system file manager, go to **≡ → System Integration → Open folders, drives, and This PC by default**; choose “Do not take over Explorer” to restore it.
5. Editions with desktop features can launch and manage fences from **≡ → Desktop Fences**. Deleting a fence does not delete files on disk.

An example plugin that casts songs to smart speaker devices via the MIoT protocol.

They appear only for interoperability and nominative fair use. This plugin **is not authorized or endorsed by any trademark holder** and has **no affiliation** with those holders.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev         # watch + auto-upload to local Songloft
npm run build       # produce dist/miot.jsplugin.zip
npm run validate    # verify plugin.json hashes
```

### Lynx frontend

The frontend references the bili plugin and uses native ReactLynx elements with `@songloft/lynx-plugin-sdk`. It outputs `main.lynx.bundle`, `main.web.bundle`, and an automatically generated HTML fallback entry. It retains six settings categories: song list, mini/full player, and devices, playback, voice, AI, scheduling, and toolbox.

Business state continues to use the standalone `@vue/reactivity`, with no Vue components or DOM renderer. HTTP, status/chat WebSocket, favorite notifications, and the back key all go through host bridging; the plugin frontend never reads Tokens. The frontend is pinned to the published `@songloft/lynx-plugin-sdk@2.21.0`: HTTP uses the public apiGet/apiPost/apiPut/apiDelete, and status and chat connections reuse PluginSocket.

The server and Lynx client in this release must be updated together. Older hosts' GET/POST bridges lack full editing and real-time connection capabilities, so updating only the plugin package is not enough. The HTML fallback requires the server to provide `web-core/`. The static sync script cleans up old Vue artifacts and keeps the entry generated by the builder. Icons use native inline SVG to avoid fonts failing inside nested frames.

# Go API client for openapi

# Introduction
The Timeweb Cloud API lets you manage cloud resources programmatically using standard HTTP requests.

Many of the features available in the Timeweb Cloud control panel are also available through the API, so you can automate your own workflows.

This documentation first describes the general design and operating principles of the API, and then the specific endpoints. Examples of requests to them are also provided.

## Requests
Requests must be made over the `HTTPS` protocol to ensure transaction encryption. The following request methods are supported:
|Method|Usage|
|--- |--- |
|GET|Retrieves data about collections and individual resources.|
|POST|For collections, creates a new resource of this type. Also used to perform actions on a specific resource.|
|PUT|Updates an existing resource.|
|PATCH|Some resources support partial updates, that is, updating only some of a resource's attributes. In this case, PATCH is used instead of the PUT method.|
|DELETE|Deletes a resource.|

The `POST`, `PUT`, and `PATCH` methods may include an object in the request body with the content type `application/json`.

xcgtb/StrimKeep.description: A dual-library film and TV management and governance panel for NAS: 115 transfers / offline downloads / channel monitoring → TMDB identification and quality upgrades → STRM generation → Emby import; library mapping for missing episodes and quality, with dual-library governance that generates a plan first, verifies each file, then cleans up.
xcgtb/StrimKeep.body:
# 🎬 StrimKeep 3.6.16

---

## 🌟 Project Highlights

### ✨ Core Features

- 🔗 **115 Share Transfer** - Paste share links (supports `?password=` extraction codes) and batch-transfer them to a specified directory
- ⚡ **Offline Download** - Submit magnet / ED2K / direct links, track progress and outputs
- 📡 **Telegram Channel Monitoring** - Public channel preview pages or private channels (user session, read-only messages); after keyword filtering, messages are routed and saved to disk
- 🎬 **Video Organization & Quality Upgrades** - TMDB identification → standardized directory `Title (Year) {tmdb-id}/Season N/`; 7-dimension quality comparison to pick the best version; subtitles, NFO, and posters saved alongside the video
- 🔗 **STRM Generation & Sync** - Outputs STRM files with 302 playback addresses; **identity is written inside the file**, so renaming or moving between libraries requires no sync registry
- 🧹 **Invalid Item Cleanup** - Confirms each network-drive file still exists before deleting; three layers of protection, with event logging
- 🖼️ **Library Mapping** - Organized by Emby media library, with 7 statuses (Complete / Missing Episodes / Superset / Still Airing / Pending Review / Already in Library / Pending Verification); missing-episode comparison and poster wall
- 🧭 **Video Discovery** - TMDB search and details, cast and related recommendations; resources you like can be transferred directly into the library
- 🔔 **Update Subscriptions & Import Notifications** - Share monitoring and channel subscriptions track updates; imports and failures are notified via Telegram
- ⚖️ **Dual-Library Governance** - Local library vs. share library compared season by season and episode by episode for quality and episode count; defective copies (missing predecessors / mid-series gaps) cleaned up per side; multi-season protection and in-library multi-version deduplication
- 🛡️ **Plan as Snapshot** - When a plan is generated, the SHA-256 / size / mtime / inode of each file and its source fingerprint are recorded; before execution, each work and each file is verified, and execution stops immediately on any change
- 📊 **Ops Support** - Task center, event log, `/metrics` endpoint, Telegram notifications

### 🏗️ Technical Architecture

- **Backend**: Python 3.12 + FastAPI + SQLite (single process, no external database)
- **Frontend**: Vue 3 + Element Plus + Vite (build artifacts are included in the image; Node is not needed to run)
- **Deployment**: Single image + Docker Compose
- **Integrations**: 115 cloud drive API, Emby, Telegram (Bot and user session), TMDB

yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: injects a system prompt that forces the agent's chain-of-thought, planning, and tool reasoning to use Simplified Chinese throughout, preventing Chinese thinking from drifting into English. Zero external dependencies; install by linking any local directory.
yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking.body:
# dsh-zh-thinking

⭐ **If this plugin helped you, feel free to [Star](https://github.com/yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking) it**. A star is the most direct encouragement for the author.

> **Project status**: This is a personal learning experiment. The author **does not commit to ongoing maintenance**.
> If a future DSH kernel upgrade breaks it, feel free to fork and modify it yourself.
> The logic lives in a single file, `lib/index.js`. All it does is register a requirement to "think in Simplified Chinese" in the system prompt.
>
> 📝 **The causes and fixes for past "kernel upgrade breaks it" incidents are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)**,
> including the full analysis of the silent disablement in 0.2.0. If your plugin shows the same symptoms, you can compare against it directly.

A host plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that keeps the agent's **internal thinking process** (chain-of-thought, step-by-step planning, reasoning before and after tool calls, and self-review) always in **Simplified Chinese**.

> **Disclaimer**: This project is inspired by [wodongx123/dsh-language-control](https://github.com/wodongx123/dsh-language-control). Its `package.json` declares the package name `@deepseek-ai/dsh-language-control`, but it **was never published to npm** and can only be installed from GitHub. This project is an **independent rewrite** based on that plugin's idea of "having the agent think in Chinese", with a different implementation. For the differences between the two, see "[Differences from the original plugin](#与原插件的区别)" below.

---

## Before installing: read the code first (about 3 minutes)

This is not a formality. The real risk of installing a third-party plugin isn't that it may have bugs. It's that **you can't confirm it isn't doing something else**.

So I suggest spending a few minutes reading it before you install:

1. Open [`lib/index.js`](https://github.com/yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking/blob/HEAD/lib/index.js). It is **73 lines total, not minified or obfuscated**.
2. You'll see it does only one thing: it calls `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` to insert a fixed Chinese paragraph into the system prompt.
3. There are no network requests, no file reads or writes, no subprocesses, no `eval`, and no dynamic `import`.

>…
